description: This file defines route logic and UI component for viewing and editing individual notes in a Remix application. It includes loader and action functions for server-side data handling and a React component for client-side rendering.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Loads a single note by ID for viewing or editing. Handles server-side rendering considerations.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles form submissions for saving or deleting a note, performing server-side updates or redirects.

methods.name: NoteDetailRoute
methods.description: React component rendering the note editing interface, utilizing loader data.
